name: 4qg6r2-tracker-stop
goal: Prove a slow hub exits before activation or restoration and packaged startup records its result.

evidence: Desktop README and incidents 0j8kry/8b9716 specify delayed job removal before bootstrap and readable install outcomes.
Existing installer update and rollback cases previously accepted immediate bootout/bootstrap and did not inspect packaged outcome logs. They now simulate 5.25/6.5s and a stuck job.
Harness recorded committed red 34b6eee690. 5.25s update rolled back; the readiness rollback attempted 8 bootstraps instead of 2.
